Test_Objective: Verify login page is reachable by an unauthenticated user as the app entry point
Steps: 1. Open the Login page URL while signed out

Test_Objective: Verify overall layout matches design: background key visual, header (SAA logo + language switcher), centered ROOT FURTHER key visual, welcome text, Google login button, footer copyright
Steps:
1. Open Login page
2. Compare all elements against design

Test_Objective: Verify language switcher defaults to VN with flag and chevron
Steps:
1. Open Login page
2. Observe language switcher
Expected_Result: Shows VN flag, label "VN", down chevron

Test_Objective: Verify login button shows Google icon and label "Đăng nhập bằng Google"
Steps:
1. Open Login page
2. Observe login button
Expected_Result: Button shows Google icon and label "Đăng nhập bằng Google"

Test_Objective: Verify login button is disabled and shows spinner while authentication is in progress
Steps:
1. Click login button
2. Observe button during auth

Test_Objective: Verify clicking login button starts Google OAuth and a successful login redirects to Homepage
Steps:
1. Click "Đăng nhập bằng Google"
2. Complete Google OAuth with valid account

Test_Objective: Verify a failed Google OAuth shows an error message
Steps:
1. Click "Đăng nhập bằng Google"
2. Cancel or fail Google OAuth
Expected_Result: Error message displayed, remains on Login

Test_Objective: Verify button enters loading state during authentication
Steps:
1. Click login button
2. Observe state during auth
Expected_Result: Spinner shown and button disabled until auth resolves

Test_Objective: Verify clicking the SAA logo navigates to the homepage
Verify clicking language switcher opens the language dropdown
Expected_Result: Language dropdown opens with options VN, EN

Test_Objective: Verify selecting a language updates the interface language and closes the dropdown
